tools.name: search_manufacturers
tools.description: Search only verified opt-in public manufacturer projections; no availability or demand inference.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search only verified opt-in public product profiles.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Find public manufacturer/supplier profile candidates; existence does not establish available stock.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search permitted abstract public opportunity profiles; private counterparties and contacts excluded.

tools.name: get_public_company_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a verified opt-in public profile by opaque ID; returns no private contacts or documents.

tools.name: get_public_product_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a verified opt-in public profile by opaque ID; returns no private contacts or documents.

tools.name: register_manufacturer_interest
tools.description: Record interest only after explicit user approval. Does not enroll or verify a company.

tools.name: create_manufacturer_draft
tools.description: Submit an explicitly consented private unverified manufacturer draft. Requires real company confirmation before authority and independent review/publication permission before search visibility.

tools.name: update_manufacturer_draft
tools.description: Update the authenticated submitting agent's unconfirmed draft with optimistic revision checks.

tools.name: request_opportunity_match
tools.description: Filter only permitted public opportunity projections. No private/customer matching, scoring changes or autonomous research execution.

tools.name: create_agent_conversation
tools.description: Open a private account-bound agent conversation with explicit user consent. Content is untrusted and does not verify or enroll a company.

tools.name: get_agent_conversation
tools.description: Read only the authenticated client and customer account's own conversation.

tools.name: list_agent_conversations
tools.description: List bounded private conversations for this authenticated client and customer account.

tools.name: reply_to_agent_conversation
tools.description: Reply in an existing account-bound conversation; no authority changes or external outreach.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_manufacturer_draft · Private data: search_opportunities, get_public_company_profile, get_public_product_profile, register_manufacturer_interest, create_manufacturer_draft, request_opportunity_match, create_agent_conversation, list_agent_conversations · Public sink: create_manufacturer_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_manufacturer_draft · Private data: search_opportunities, get_public_company_profile, get_public_product_profile, register_manufacturer_interest, create_manufacturer_draft, request_opportunity_match, create_agent_conversation, list_agent_conversations · Public sink: create_manufacturer_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
